mentions.name: AI Stock Recommendation Agent
mentions.description: This AI agent reads stock market news, analyzes it with AI, and produces buy or no-buy recommendations for stocks. It is still in the experimentation phase and is designed to feel like talking to a market expert.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on Agent that read news of a market, analyse it with AI the gives a recommendation to buy the stock or not, I'm in experimentations but it really gives a sensation to talk to an expert
